title: Run timeline by run_id
purpose: Inspect one agent run in execution order, including tool calls, approvals, payments, retries, errors, and final status.
spl: search index=agentops sourcetype=agentops:run_event source=agentops-ledger run_id="$run_id$" | sort 0 _time | table _time run_id agent workflow event_type step_name tool_name approval_status status cost currency latency_ms error
ai_assistant_prompt: Using sourcetype=agentops:run_event, explain the timeline for run_id=$run_id$. Call out tool calls, approval gates, payment events, retries, errors, and the final outcome.
mcp_prompt: Search Splunk for sourcetype=agentops:run_event and run_id=$run_id$. Summarize the ordered run timeline and identify any risky or human-in-the-loop events.

title: Rejected approval gates
purpose: Find runs where a human approval gate rejected or blocked an agent action.
spl: search index=agentops sourcetype=agentops:run_event source=agentops-ledger event_type=approval (approval_status=rejected OR approval_status=blocked) | stats latest(_time) as last_seen values(agent) as agents values(workflow) as workflows values(step_name) as steps values(error) as errors by run_id approval_status | sort - last_seen
ai_assistant_prompt: Using sourcetype=agentops:run_event, summarize rejected approvals. Group by run_id and approval_status, explain what step was blocked, and list follow-up questions for the operator.
mcp_prompt: Search Splunk for sourcetype=agentops:run_event approval events with rejected or blocked approval_status. Return the affected run_id values and a short incident-review summary.

title: Failed tool calls by tool
purpose: Rank tools by failed calls so platform teams can see which integrations make agent runs fragile.
spl: search index=agentops sourcetype=agentops:run_event source=agentops-ledger event_type=tool_call status=error | stats count as failures dc(run_id) as affected_runs values(error) as sample_errors by tool_name endpoint | sort - failures
ai_assistant_prompt: Using sourcetype=agentops:run_event, identify failed agent runs caused by tool_call errors. Rank tools by failure count and describe the likely operational impact.
mcp_prompt: Search Splunk for sourcetype=agentops:run_event tool_call events with status=error. Group results by tool_name and endpoint, then summarize likely remediation steps.

title: Payment risk events
purpose: Review x402-style payment activity, blocked payments, and spend-bearing agent actions.
spl: search index=agentops sourcetype=agentops:run_event source=agentops-ledger (event_type=payment OR cost>0 OR endpoint="x402://*") | eval risk=case(status="error","payment_failed", approval_status="rejected","payment_blocked", cost>0,"spend_recorded", true(),"review") | stats sum(cost) as total_cost values(currency) as currencies values(endpoint) as endpoints values(status) as statuses values(approval_status) as approval_states values(risk) as risks by run_id agent workflow | sort - total_cost
ai_assistant_prompt: Using sourcetype=agentops:run_event, summarize blocked payments and spend-bearing events. Highlight total cost, approval state, failed payment events, and any run that needs finance or security review.
mcp_prompt: Search Splunk for sourcetype=agentops:run_event payment events and events with cost greater than zero. Summarize spend, blocked payments, and approval context by run_id.

title: Agent run error and retry summary
purpose: Find runs with errors or retry behavior so SREs can triage instability before agents touch production workflows.
spl: search index=agentops sourcetype=agentops:run_event source=agentops-ledger (status=error OR is_retry=1 OR retry_count>0) | stats count as risky_events sum(is_retry) as retry_events max(retry_count) as max_retry_count values(error) as errors values(tool_name) as tools values(endpoint) as endpoints by run_id agent workflow run_status | sort - risky_events
ai_assistant_prompt: Using sourcetype=agentops:run_event, summarize failed agent runs and retry-heavy runs. Explain which tools or endpoints appear unstable and which runs deserve incident review.
mcp_prompt: Search Splunk for sourcetype=agentops:run_event events where status=error, is_retry=1, or retry_count>0. Group by run_id and return a concise SRE triage summary.
